title: Ad-hoc cross-stakeholder ask census
description: One-off census of outstanding cross-stakeholder asks collected from last two weeks of syncs and incident retros. Purpose: create a compact single-row view for GTM/product/infra to triage quick wins and owner handoffs.
scoring_method: Priority score = impact(1-5) * effort_factor(1-3). Effort factor: 1 small (<2 dev-days), 2 medium (2-7), 3 large (>7). Color buckets: 12+ red, 6-11 amber, <=5 green.
instructions: How to use: 1) Add new ask as one row. 2) Set owner and add ticket link in 'notes'. 3) Triage weekly during ops sync; move completed to 'archived' sheet. Quick filters: owner, team, priority_bucket. Rows with unknown owner should be pinged in channel '#crossstake-asks'.
